findings.evidence: Hypotheses are `d : ι → ℤ`, `r : ι → K`, `hr`, `{i : ι}`, `hd : ¬ (p:ℤ) ∣ d i`; nothing constrains the family (no `htop`, no independence, no `Finite ι`). Contrast `Multiquadratic/MultiquadraticSplitting.lean:251` `ncard_primesOver_multiquadratic_iff`, whose statement is genuinely about the whole family.
findings.fix: State the single-element form (`{x : K} (hx : x ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ K d)`) in `TauCeti/NumberTheory/NumberField/Frobenius.lean`, and keep only the family specialization plus `isArithFrobAt_eq_one_iff` (which genuinely uses `adjoin ℚ (Set.range r) = ⊤`) in Multiquadratic/.
findings.issue: `isArithFrobAt_apply_sqrt` has no multiquadratic hypothesis — it says only that a Frobenius at Q sends any x : K with x² = d to legendreSym p d • x; the `ι`-indexed family is cosmetic (each `i` is handled independently), and the namespace is already `TauCeti.NumberField`. It is a general number-field fact sitting in a roadmap-specific directory.

findings.issue: Nothing in the repo imports this file: `grep -rn "NumberField.Frobenius" TauCeti/` returns no hits, yet its module docstring says it packages existence "in the form the multiquadratic roadmap's Layer 1 consumes (TauCeti.NumberTheory.Multiquadratic.Frobenius ...)". Multiquadratic/Frobenius.lean takes `hσ : IsArithFrobAt ℤ σ Q` as a hypothesis and never obtains σ from these lemmas, so the stated dependency is fictional.

findings.fix: Give these one home: de-privatize the `𝓞 K` square-root packaging (`ringGen`/`ringGen_sq`/integrality) into a shared file both Multiquadratic files import, and have MultiquadraticSplitting use the new generic `algebraMap_int_mem_iff_dvd` rather than keeping a `𝓞 K`-specific copy.
findings.issue: Private helpers duplicate ones already in the sibling file `Multiquadratic/MultiquadraticSplitting.lean`: `isIntegral_of_sq_intCast` vs `mq_isIntegral_gen` (line 40), the `⟨r i, _⟩ ^ 2 = algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K) (d i)` packaging vs `ringGen_sq` (line 62), and `LegendreSymbol/Frobenius.lean`'s `algebraMap_int_mem_iff_dvd` vs `algebraMap_int_mem_iff_dvd_of_liesOver` (line 71) — same proof term.

summary: Two placement problems: the general Frobenius-on-a-square-root lemma is stated with no multiquadratic hypothesis inside Multiquadratic/, and the new NumberField/Frobenius.lean is imported by nothing despite its docstring claiming the multiquadratic file consumes it. Imports themselves are fine.
